programme.desc: With 1000 miles of coastline and 250 miles of world class beaches, to many people the Dominican Republic is known as a tropical paradise. Pounding surf, ideal beaches and warm raging water. This week on Facing Waves, we're paddling the Dominican Republic. Luke Hopkins takes his stand up paddleboard on an exploratory journey along the coast, through the rivers, and in the surf that surrounds this idyllic scenery. Come join us!

programme.title: What Sup - Episode 5
programme.desc: On this week's episode we have comedian and viral  video sensation, Megan Mackay. She is best known for her comedic YouTube makeup tutorial videos, and her videos have been seen by more than 4.5 million people worldwide. Will she have the skills to jump on our paddleboard and take on our challenges?

programme.title: Bol D'Or: The Swiss Do It Better
programme.desc: The Bol D’Or Mirabaud is the most important inland lake regatta in the world. Taking place in Switzerland, a landlocked nation that sits on top of the sailing world with multiple successes whether in the Olympic, Offshore or in Grand Prix Racing formats, and champion of two America’s Cup victories. The race started in 1939 and it is a symbolic race that brings together the best of Switzerland’s sailing tradition.Every year they welcome mono-hulls and multihulls on Lake Geneva, starting in the city of Geneva. More than 500 boats fight each other on this 123 kilometre (66.5 nautical miles) course from Geneva to Le Bouveret and back. It is a national treasure that every summer gathers thousands of spectators to the shores of Lake Geneva and really shows how the Swiss indeed do it better.Watch the race and become one with the beauty of Switzerland’s background, available on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Sailing Deejay - Episode 5
programme.desc: Today we are going to visit the Hippie Market at Formentera, famous all over the world for its unique type of creativity. We will be making new friends that will be teaching us about their favourite music styles and, this close to the end, will our two protagonists be getting sentimental? Not without a mojito at the beach first! Let's dive in!

programme.title: Sailing Deejay - Episode 6
programme.desc: Our adventure is coming to an end, but the party never stops! Sam and Max have lived their adventure in Ibiza and Formentera, and have to get back home to show family and friends their new skills. We are sailing one last time and partying until dawn to make the most out of our time in Ibiza.

programme.title: H2O Racing: F1H2O World Championship - Ep.1 - Season Review 2025
H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship - GP of Indonesia (ENDURANCE - Dairi Cup)
Wind Masters - Episode 4: Skradin, Vodice, Tribunj
Discovering Saint Maarten
programme.desc: One of the most captivating and curious islands of the entire Caribbean is without doubt Saint Maarten. The island is split into two nationalities while also hosting many more, becoming a hub of diverse excitement where the best of different cultures takes place. This is probably because the northern half of the island belongs to France while the southern side is part of the Kingdom of the Netherlands, something highly uncommon around the world.Experience a 12-meter sailboat race, planes flying 50 overhead on crystal blue watered beaches, long streets filled with cultural fusion and wildlife tours and an underwater helmet-diving excursion by the side of a submarine wreck in Discovering Saint Maarten.Broadcasted on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: America's Cup Insight - Episode 2
programme.desc: Welcome to another episode of America's Cup Insight. Today, we are at the heart of the British challenge inside the Land Rover B.A.R. We will discover more about the team, the players and the big family behind the boat. Also, find out how boundaries are changing the game and find out more about the wings of change.Plunge into the action with AC35 Insight.

programme.title: The Ocean Race - Leg 7 Genova - HL
Qatar Airways GKA Kite World Tour Magazines - Episode 1
IWWF World Waterski Championships - Ep1 - Highlight
Kite Masters - Episode 5
programme.desc: First stop for this episode is the exotic destination and kiteboarding playground of Mauritius, for one of the most high-profile and biggest kite-foiling events: the Hydrofoil Pro Tour. From one island to another, we leave the exotic racetracks of Mauritius and head to Cagliari on Sardinia for another exciting gathering of the world's best kitefoiling riders. The World Championship also marked the close of the 2017 Kitefoil Gold Cup World Series.

programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 6
programme.desc: In this episode, we move to Dongshan, China for the 2017 Dongshan China International Kiteboarding Open. Combining culture with heritage, this small island, located along the Taiwan Strait, hosts a population of 200,000. The Youth Olympic Games is a hot topic in the Kiteboarding community, eagerly anticipated by riders and supporters. Reflecting an exciting and new race format, the slalom/boarder-cross is designed to challenge the riders' ability to stay in control, while maintaining maximum speed.

programme.title: The Boat Show - Episode 1
programme.desc: Welcome to the sixth season of The Boat Show, the program dedicated to nautical advancements, sports and excitement. Today, we are on board the Pirelli 1, 100 Cabin before getting on board the new model of the Zar 95 Sport Luxury. Finally, we discover the center console from the Blackwater 39. Get comfortable and enjoy!

programme.title: The Boat Show - Episode 2
programme.desc: In this second episode of The Boat Show, we are ready to discover how Mercury Marine has invested over 800 million dollars to improve its own products by exploring the Mercury V8 300 Fourstroke. Then, we discover more about the ZF Company that specializes in transportation before getting on board the Hylas H48. Stay tuned!

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 3
programme.desc: Welcome back sailors! In today's episode, we're taking you to one of the most beautiful Dalmatian islands - the island of Brac. Famous for its enchanting small towns that have kept an air of tradition, it also offers a taste of top class gastronomy and is recognized for its white stone that is used for buildings around Croatia and the world.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 4
programme.desc: Welcome to Vodice! This is one of the country's tourist centers known for its liveliness and variety of water sports. In this episode, we will be attending the Kornati regattas, exploring the beautiful Jezera on the island of Murter and much more. Come join us on Sail-Ho Croatia!

programme.title: Eat Like a Yogi - Course Intro
programme.desc: This course is focused on merging Ayurveda with modern nutritional science and a dedicated yoga practice so that you can work toward becoming your highest self. But what exactly is Ayurveda? Tune in to find out and discover what this course is all about.

programme.title: Eat Like a Yogi - Breakfast for Your Dosha
programme.desc: Today you are going to learn how to start your day in the most effective way according to Ayurveda. Find out why it’s important to have a nourishing breakfast that’s designed for your specific mind-body type. Plus, this episode offers three Smoothie Bowl recipes – one for each of the doshas – that will nourish your body and set the tone for a great day. Less than 40 minutes. Complete Recipes Here - https://bit.ly/2xUOMEQ

programme.title: Opening the Hips
programme.desc: Join Kino for some yoga drills that will help you work on opening the hips with some external hip rotation. With this video, you will gain a greater understanding of the movement mechanics involved in the action of external hip rotation. Build strength in all the muscles that are involved in opening the hips through this 40-minute practice.

programme.title: Facing Injury in the Practice
programme.desc: When it comes to yoga practice, there's nothing more difficult that facing an injury.

programme.title: Kino in Berlin
programme.desc: Dive into the rich culture, historic wonder and alternative lifestyle of the amazing city of Berlin. If you’ve spent any significant amount of time traveling, you know it can be hard on both your mind and your body. In this episode, you’ll get an inside look at Kino’s morning ritual, which she insists is part of what keeps her grounded amidst all the traveling. Follow Kino around the beautiful city as she teaches to a group of dedicated yogis and gives you an inside look at the city’s tourist sights through the eyes of yoga. Brush up on your Berlin Art and History knowledge as Kino visits the famous TV Tower, The Berlin Wall, one of the city’s last remaining Occupy Buildings, the Berlin Eastside Galleries and more. This episode is just over 20 minutes long.

programme.title: Yoga Is Love
programme.desc: Today's practice is all about love. Start practice by tuning into breath and body, bringing a special attention to the heartspace. Take a moment for feeling into the vibration of the heart, welcoming a feeling of receptivity. Warm yourself up as Kino brings extra attention to opening the chest and front body. Next we segue into finding and loving your particular expression of Gomukhasana, the cow facing posture. Remember that the cow is a sacred symbol of giving and love as you feel into the postures heart opening effects.

programme.title: Utthita Hasta Padangusthasana
programme.desc: This practice starts with breath awareness before moving into a prop supported physical practice. Use a chair to make the challenge of balance work more accessible.

programme.title: Lolasana
programme.desc: This flow uses a chair supported sun salutation to get you started then flows through standing poses before finishing up with some accessible work in the arm balance Lolasana

programme.title: The Pelvic Floor - Forgive
programme.desc: The journey of yoga is a journey of deep intimacy with the body. In this class you will begin to explore the pelvic floor and the concept of forgiveness. Allow the natural intelligence of the inner body to shine cultivate of deep awareness of the intimate, inner space of the body in this 30 minute practice.

programme.title: Plank
programme.desc: Join Kino for a short, gentle practice that is centered around core engagement and the plank pose

programme.title: Eat Like a Yogi - Meditation for Kapha
programme.desc: As you’ve learned, Ayurveda recommends different yoga and meditation practices for each of the doshas. In this episode, Sahara Rose will guide you through a meditation that’s designed specifically for Kapha type people.

programme.title: Meditation Now - Sharpen the Mind
programme.desc: Find a comfortable seat, close your eyes and imagine yourself sitting in the warm sand on a beautiful beach as you join Kino for today’s meditation. Sharpen the edge of the mind as you bring your awareness to a single point of focus.

programme.title: Eat Like a Yogi - Meditation for Kapha
programme.desc: As you’ve learned, Ayurveda recommends different yoga and meditation practices for each of the doshas. In this episode, Sahara Rose will guide you through a meditation that’s designed specifically for Kapha type people.

programme.title: Breathwork
programme.desc: Use this practice to work with improving your 3-dimensional breathing.

programme.title: Standing Postures
programme.desc: Follow Mark as he walks your through techniques that will help you improve your function in standing poses.

programme.title: Yoga Is Patience
programme.desc: For many of us, patience does not come naturally. this class brings us an opportunity to understand patience through the twisting posture Marichasana C. Join Kino as she guides you into embodiment through breath awareness and gentle movement. Be patient and kind with your body as you move into the practice and a deeper twist through the spinal axis.

programme.title: Yoga Is Stillness
programme.desc: One of the key lessons of yoga is stillness, known as Nirodaha in Sanskrit. We will use the headstand position to practice approaching situations with calm and serenity. This class will help you build a strong base and increase awareness in the parts of your body that will support this inversion, especially the core. Don’t be afraid as we approach this challenge, Kino will offer variations so that all levels can experience the meditative stillness of headstand.

programme.title: Yoga, Money & Conscious Living With Sandy Fernandez
programme.desc: Join Kino for a sit-down conversation with Sandy Fernandez, founder of Karmic Currency.

programme.title: Love Your Body
programme.desc: Come back into alignment through awareness of the body. Use the breath as an anchor to cultivate present moment awareness. Redirect the attention from the external world to the inner world, beginning with the sensation of breath along the inside of the nostrils. Learn to feel what is rather than generating a story. Allow yourself to feel safe and loved through the practice of mindfulness.

programme.title: Seated Position for Meditation
programme.desc: Find the meditation position, (legs crossed, seated in a chair or laying down) that is accessible for you.

programme.title: Yoga Is Sanctuary
programme.desc: Today’s lesson is about sanctuary and how to find a place of calm and peace deep within yourself. We’ll use the backbend Ustrasana, or Camel Pose, to dive into that inner world. Kino will guide you through warm ups and then a series of backbends that will challenge you. The idea is to work outside of your comfort zone, just a little, so you seek a source of strength from deep within. As you embrace the challenge you can also embrace a sense of sanctuary and connect to an inner space of faith and grace.

Join Kino in developing awareness of the pure, non-judgmental ‘is-ness’ of yoga.

programme.title: Yoga Is Unity
programme.desc: The traditional definition of yoga is unity. We will explore this concept through the restorative Pigeon Pose. Begin practice with a reflection on the connection between breath, body and mind. Next, move through a series of long holds in child’s pose, puppy poses and forward folding. Take a supported hip opener using props if you have them handy and then move into another long hold, this time in Pigeon Pose. Take note of any sensations and feelings that arise, offering yourself true care and opening up to a sense of wholeness.

programme.title: Documentary - Abandoned Dreams
programme.desc: The abandoned boat dilemma is one of the most frustrating and alarming issues facing British Columbia's coastal communities. Reaching the end of their life cycle, with limited disposal options and almost no way to track ownership, hundreds of old boats are being left to rot, and sink or drift onto beaches and shorelines around our province. The result is a province-wide problem that affects coastal navigation, tourism and the environment. Abandoned Dreams looks into the root causes of this derelict boat epidemic and the future plans for safe boat disposal and recycling in BC.

Longines FEI Jumping Nations Cup - Sopot
Horse Academy Pro - Chapter 2
programme.desc: Bruno Chimirri lectures the students on what is needed to become an equestrian pro. He talks about the bond between a horse and rider, how he manages stress at competitions and the mental preparation he undergoes when detecting possible problems in the field. Then, the students get on the reins to practice jumps.

programme.title: Longines FEI Jumping Nations Cup (Full Competition) - Ep7 - Falsterbo
Longines Global Champions Tour - Ep4 - Madrid
CSI5* Casas Novas Longines - Longines Grand Prix
programme.desc: The A Coruña LGCT international show jumping competition will be held at the Casas Novas Equestrian Center every year in mid-July.

programme.title: FEI Equestrian World - Episode 7
programme.desc: We return to Canada to meet more children who are benefiting from equine therapy before heading to Poland to enjoy the third leg of the FEI Eventing Nations Cup in Strzegom. Then, we will discover how a charity is helping to improve the lives of working horses in Mexico and we will reflect on the 2017 FEI European Jumping final with champion Peder Fredricson.

programme.title: FEI Equestrian World - Episode 8
programme.desc: In this week's episode we will meet a former FEI World Jumping Champion and some of his most famous horses at his house in the Netherlands. Then, we go to Athens to see how an organisation is helping rehabilitate and rehome equines throughout Greece. In the second part of today's show we will be focussing on the Longines FEI European Championship for Dressage, Para-Dressage and Jumping. You are in for a ride!

programme.title: Sunshine Tour - GP Equine America
programme.desc: The Equine America Grand Prix is one of the most demanding courses in the Andalucía Sunshine Tour. This year, from an initial field of 48, just five riders have managed to get through to the jump off with clear rounds, while the next five places were taken by riders who finished with time penalties. Designed by Grégory Bodo and Alain Lhopital, this 1.55m show jumping course has the crowd go crazy in their seats. Are you going to miss out?

programme.title: FEI Icons - Episode 5 - Boyd Exell
programme.desc: In this episode we focus on one of the most iconic name in the sport of carriage driving, the Australian Boyd Exell. Fascinated by horses from a very young age, he moved to the United Kingdom to develop this early talent, and soon he became the first Athlete in history of the sport to compete in three different World Championships: horse singles, horse pairs and four in hand.

programme.title: FEI Icons - Episode 6 - Martin Fuchs
programme.desc: FEI Icons is a series looking back at the careers of some of the most successful and influential equestrian athletes of the 21st century. In this episode, we are focussing on the Swiss sensation, Martin Fuchs, who at only 27 years old had already propelled himself to the top of the Show jumping world. Discover his story.

programme.title: Warwickshire Cup - Final Lovelocks vs Monterosso Vikings
programme.desc: The Warwickshire Cup, organized by Cirencester Park Polo Club, is one of the most prestigious events in the English high handicap. Teams of 4 people compete in this event to raise above their heads the Cup. At the end, only a team can remain. Don't miss out on the 2020 final of Lovelocks vs. Monterosso Vikings.

programme.title: German High Goal Polo Championship - German High Goal Polo Championship
programme.desc: The German Polo Tour has been the top polo league in Germany since 2010. Now, rivalling teams will have to compete in the Prussian & Country Club Berlin-Brandenburg for the Cup. The final between Carfactory and Riller & Schmauck is now on. Enjoy the competition and follow the top level of german polo in Horse TV.

programme.title: FEI Icons - Episode 1 - Icons of Tryon
programme.desc: The FEI disciplines - Jumping, Dressage, Para-Dressage, Eventing, Driving, Endurance, Vaulting and Reining have been coming together since 1990. In this special edition of FEI Icons, we go back to September 2018 when the USA hosted the 8th FEI World Equestrian Games at the Tryon International Equestrian Centre, in North Carolina.

programme.title: FEI Icons - Episode 2 - Horses of History
programme.desc: We can only be as good as the horse we are riding. The rider and the horse need to feel a connection, a sort of partnership for both to be near a perfect level. Then, incredible things happen. In this special episode we relive the biggest moments of some of the greatest horses in the history of Jumping, Dressage and Eventing.

programme.desc: The CSI5*W Damm Trophy is one of the toughest and most awaited competition during the Madrid Horse Week. Will Portuguese rider Luciana Diniz repeat her 2019 success with Vertigo du Desert? Let's find out in the 2021 edition of the CSI5*-W Estrella Damm Trophy.

programme.title: FEI Equestrian World - Episode 9
programme.desc: In this episode of FEI Equestrian World, we travel to the Longines FEI Eventing European Championships in Germany and learn more about a machine that helps create the perfect arena footing for horses. We will then return to Mexico to see how a farriery training school improves the lives of working equines. Finally, we will look ahead to one of the most important team jumping events taking place soon.

programme.title: FEI Equestrian World - Episode 10
programme.desc: In FEI Equestrian World we meet the Riding for the Disabled Association to celebrate its 50th anniversary. Then we will learn about a project that's connecting urban communities with the equestrian world.

programme.title: FEI Equestrian World - Episode 9

Longines Masters of New York
programme.desc: The Longines Masters of New York proudly offer unparalleled first-class sport attracting the world's top-ranked equestrian athletes to the Big Apple. This heart-pounding equestrian sport is a one in a lifetime experience for riders and spectators likewise. It divides in classes such as the unique Longines Speed Challenge, dubbed the fastest class in the world, and the Longines Grand Prix. If this was not enough it is accompanied by live performances, luxury shopping in the Prestige Village, delicious cuisine and more surprises we don’t want to miss out. Taking up the spotlight, the Riders Masters Cup showcases two rounds of one-on-one speed duels to decide the winning team in a transatlantic battle of Riders USA vs. Riders Europe. A real match between the world's two major equestrian powers, the USA and Europe. Which continent will defeat the other? Find it out on HorseTV.

programme.title: Sunshine Tour - GP Suzuki
programme.desc: The CSI4* Suzuki Grand Prix is an emotional and exciting class. Horses jump as the crowd buzzes from the grades in a course designed by Santiago Varela. At the end of the first round, only 8 international riders got through to the jump off: Pénélope Leprevost, Cian O'Connor, Henk Van de Pol, Holly Smith, Pedro Junqueira, Laura Kraut, Marcel Marschall and Anthony Condon. With so much talent, the jump off was incredibly competitive in the 1.45m course. Relive the best moments of the Suzuki Grand Prix 2022 edition!

programme.title: Sunshine Tour - GP Suzuki
programme.desc: The CSI4* Suzuki Grand Prix is an emotional and exciting class. Horses jump as the crowd buzzes from the grades in a course designed by Santiago Varela. With so much talent, the jump off was incredibly competitive in the 1.45m course. Relive the best moments of the Suzuki Grand Prix 2022 edition!

programme.title: Longines Masters of New York
programme.desc: The Longines Masters of New York proudly offer unparalleled first-class sport attracting the world's top-ranked equestrian athletes to the Big Apple. This heart-pounding equestrian sport is a one in a lifetime experience for riders and spectators likewise. It divides in classes such as the unique Longines Speed Challenge, dubbed the fastest class in the world, and the Longines Grand Prix. If this was not enough it is accompanied by live performances, luxury shopping in the Prestige Village, delicious cuisine and more surprises we don’t want to miss out. Taking up the spotlight, the Riders Masters Cup showcases two rounds of one-on-one speed duels to decide the winning team in a transatlantic battle of Riders USA vs. Riders Europe. A real match between the world's two major equestrian powers, the USA and Europe. Which continent will defeat the other? Find it out on HorseTV.

The boys share incredible training stories, talk about some of their toughest match-ups and much more. Thanks for watching and stay tune for PART 2 !!!

programme.title: American Grappling - Brandon Quick
programme.desc: American Grappler kicks off this season with an all-access look inside Team USA as they continue their quest for Gold at the World Championships. Being in first place, the team has a target on their back from the rest of the world; and with Russia, the most winning team in history returning Team USA must recruit the best athletes America has to offer to prove why they are number one.

programme.title: ADCC Opens Dallas- Journey from Newcomer to Champion
programme.desc: You’re watching a TGN original on The ADCC 2023 Dallas Opens. Check out 17 year old phenom Michael Sainz and returning athletes like Luke Griffith & Giancarlo Bodoni. We take a deeper look at these competitors mindset going into the Opens, what they expect with the ADCC rule set and how they’re preparing for Trials.

programme.title: Mat Made - Nashville
programme.desc: Kenny visits Liberdade Jiu Jitsu in Nashville, TN with special guest and UFC veteran Din Thomas. See who wins the hot chicken challenge as they gulp beer down, tell Heather’s emotional redemption story, and ride mechanical bulls at the Wild Beaver Saloon.

programme.title: Breaking -The Maya Boys represent at Freestyle Session
programme.desc: Join us in this breathtaking journey of The Maya Boys, where breaking is more than a dance - it's a way of life, a family affair, and a pursuit of dreams. Watch as they make their mark on the world stage, driven by talent, hard work, and the unbreakable bond of family.

programme.title: NCAA D3 Men’s Wrestling: Augsburg vs The College of New Jersey
programme.desc: Augsburg takes on The College of New Jersey in a high-level NCAA Division III men’s wrestling showdown. With one of the sport’s most decorated programs in action, expect fast pace, strong fundamentals, and competitive battles across every weight.

programme.title: Training with Roberto 'Cyborg' Abreu - By Stuart Cooper
programme.desc: Roberto "Cyborg"Abreu takes us through a day in training. Starting with 8 different BJJ warm up drills, and some sparring rounds with Vagner Rocha and Joao Gabriel Rocha.

programme.title: 2020 WCT-USA EXTREME BATTLES Ep1
programme.desc: 2020 WCT-USA EXTREME BATTLES Ep1

programme.title: American Grappling Podcast- Ft. Dr. Ivan Rascon Aguilar
programme.desc: In this Episode of the AGF Podcast, Brandon Quick interviews Gastroenterologist Ivan Rascon - Aguilar, MD about the health benefits of the Carnivore Diet, how its changed Brandon’s life and how Dr. Rascon - Aguilar is helping hundreds reverse preventable diseases and how a dietary and lifestyle change can improve wellness and athletic performance. Keep an eye out for more American Grappling Federation content here on The Grappling Network.

programme.desc: Two Ming patriots spend their days helping the weak and rescuing damsels in distress. This alum gets them in trouble, though, as they are captured and then volunteered to go after the fearsome Dragon Gang, a tribe of bandits that have been terrorizing the land.

programme.title: Hands Of Death

programme.title: The Black Dragon's Revenge
programme.desc: Three rival gangs embark on a search for Bruce Lee's handwritten "finger fighting " manual.

programme.title: Death Machines

programme.title: Dragon Fist
programme.desc: Tong Huo-wan (Jackie Chan) seeks redress from the man responsible for his master's death, but becomes entangled in a feud between a local clan and gangsters.

programme.title: Kill Point
programme.desc: An L.A. cop investigating the rape and murder of his wife traces the crime to a psycho biker gang that smuggles guns. He teams up with an FBI agent to stop them and catch his wife's killers.

programme.title: Nine Death of the Ninja
programme.desc: A young martial artist-in-training named Tiger (Lou) is being stalked by Evil Ninja.

programme.title: The Black Draguon
programme.desc: Decent, simple, honest Chinese farmhand and ace martial artist Tai-Lin travels to the Philippines seeking his fortune. He gets a job as a dock worker and then discovers that his employers are involved in a crime syndicate that smuggles opium.

programme.title: The Doll Squad
programme.desc: Squad of beautiful government agents tries to catch saboteurs.

programme.title: El Secuestro
programme.desc: Un joven con talento en la música sueña con ser un gran artista hasta que conoce al hijo de un poderoso narcotraficante colombiano quién promete ayudarlo a cambio de que trabaje para ellos. El joven no se imagina en que mundo se está metiendo. La fama le costará lo que más ama.

programme.title: El Duende
programme.desc: Rosalía se muda a la ciudad junto a su hijo pequeño, Ramiro. Con la ayuda de una conocida, consigue encontrar vivienda. La casa ha estado cerrada por décadas, y tiene un horno antiguo. Lo que Rosalía ignora es que dentro del horno habita un duende que tiene por costumbre robar niños.

programme.title: 4 Metros
programme.desc: 4 METROS relata, en tono de comedia romántica, la historia de un hombre entrando en la crisis de los 40. Joaquín tiene un zumbido en los oídos y poco sabe de sí mismo. Se ha dejado llevar sin intervenir demasiado en sus deseos. No escucha su voz interior. Su vida afectiva y laboral no tienen rumbo. El zumbido quizá sea la expresión, no asumida ni entendida todavía, de un ruido metafórico de la vida gritándole por dónde ir. Su novia tiene 20 años menos, aparece la presión social y familiar sobre la paternidad, sentirse útil, la vocación, el trabajo y cómo ser feliz. Hasta que otra mujer irrumpe y todo parece acomodarse. Pero siempre el orden debe ser interno. Así, como si el destino tomara la palabra, su vida cambiará 4 metros abajo del agua, donde aparece un sendero para encontrar la identidad.

programme.title: Expediente 53 2.0
programme.desc: Mientras el líder de los delincuentes de la ciudad, Jack se reúne con el demonio Lilly alias Abal en un antro/table para matar y tomar las almas de sus víctimas. El FBI pide ayuda de unos sacerdotes solo que el hermano menor de Jack es poseído por Abal y ahora Jack tendrá que tomar una de las decisiones más difíciles de su vida.

programme.title: Baile Peligroso
programme.desc: Miluska es una cantante, que se gana la vida haciendo shows musicales para un hotel turístico en el sur de Perú. Durante las presentaciones conoce una variedad de empresarios de todo nivel, entre ellos está Don Mauro, un señor respetable, que admira mucho a Miluska, Carlos Reyes, un traficante de mujeres que se hace pasar por empresario. Al ser cliente frecuente del hotel se gana cierta confianza con las chicas, un día le ofrece a Miluska hacer un show para su hotel en otra provincia, pero no sabían que caerían en una trampa difícil de escapar.

programme.title: Codón Es Una Máquina
programme.desc: Dos amigos se reúnen para planear la creación de una película con un equipo de producción filmando el proceso, dos cuarentones con problemitas están muy decididos a hacer la famosa película de la que llevan años hablando. Se vienen tan arriba que hasta ya graban el making of... y hasta están haciendo un casting, aunque no tienen ni guión ni puñetera idea de lo que van a rodar. Y lo peor: no sospechan que están en las manos de un loco peligroso.

programme.title: El Mariachi Gringo
programme.desc: Comedia romántica sobre un joven de la América profunda que -tras tener como improvisado maestro de guitarra a un emigrante- viaja a México huyendo de su vida tediosa y de su familia, para ejercitarse como mariachi.

programme.title: Canon: Fidelidad al Límite
programme.desc: Mariana de 35 años, es una arquitecta que trabaja y es socia de un importante despacho de arquitectos, está casada con Julián de 40 años, quien es corresponsal de guerra. Está enamorados, felices, con relación sexual cotidiana. Son padre de dos hijos de 14 y 17 año. En el juego sexual, Julián menciona que no le importaría la infidelidad a condición de estar enterado del hecho con detalles.

programme.title: Bendita Calamidad
programme.desc: Los hermanos Fayos, Anselmo y Ricardo, están con el agua al cuello. Su bar no funciona, el Ayuntamiento lo clausura y se ha agotado el dinero que, para ir tirando, solicitaron a unos prestamistas que no se andan con contemplaciones a la hora de cobrar. Piden consejo a un abogado poco amigo de la ley, Antonio Orestes, que les sugiere una vía rápida para acabar con sus problemas: El secuestro exprés de un constructor de Tarazona.

programme.title: Aerosol
programme.desc: El líder de una banda mexicana mata a un oponente en la guerra de pandillas en los 80's, por lo que huye a la ciudad de Los Ángeles, California. Dieciocho años después regresa al barrio sin un objetivo definido, sólo para encontrar a su hermano menor, involucrado en las pandillas de hoy. El crimen organizado utiliza niños para distribuir droga en los barrios. En combatir la corrupción y el crimen que hay en el barrio, Nuk encuentra un significado para su retorno y un camino para redimir las muertes que causó

programme.title: Fantasías
programme.desc: La historia de Brenda y Antonio, una pareja de clase media con dos hijos adolescentes y una vida sexual aburrida, en busca de nuevas experiencias, primero con su sexy sirvienta. Más tarde, siguiendo el consejo de Esther, una amiga mayor que tiene un estilo de vida swinger junto con su esposo, deciden explorar la posibilidad de despertar una nueva pasión al ligar con Miguel y Claudia, una pareja swinger. Pero luego llegan los problemas.

programme.title: Borrar de la Memoria
programme.desc: Una historia de amor se transforma en una historia de persecuciones y asesinatos sin esclarecer en el contexto de la masacre estudiantil de octubre de 1968. Más de 40 años después, un periodista tenaz se da a la tarea de aclarar los crímenes bajo condiciones muy peligrosas, con el objetivo de llevar la verdad ante la justicia. Ello representa un esfuerzo dedicado a obligar a un país a reconocer la negación de la reconciliación y el cierre de trágicos acontecimientos políticos y sociales en su historia.

programme.title: Amar
programme.desc: Carlos quiere pero Susana no. Joel no quiere pero Patricia lo obliga. Gabriel lo espera pero Martha no se lo da. Amado lo busca con una gringa y lo pierde. Benito lo tiene toda la vida. Concha se lo lleva más allá del sistema solar. Todos lo quieren y todos lo dan pero unos no lo reciben y otros quieren más. Así es Amar.

programme.title: Expediente 53 3.0
programme.desc: Un extraño ser del más allá regresa con sed de venganza para acabar con todas las personas que lo han estado atormentando por todos estos años, decidiendo poseer a Jack y darle más fuerza a Baal.

programme.title: El Tirabeque
programme.desc: Sebas es redactor de un periódico digital que nadie lee, está en trámites de divorcio y tiene problemas con el alcohol. Toda su vida se desmorona hasta que le encargan un reportaje sobre los tirabeques. Lo que en un inicio parecía un trabajo tranquilo se convertirá en una investigación de consecuencias impredecibles.

programme.title: El Peluquero Romántico
programme.desc: La vida del barbero de barrio Víctor transcurre bastante tranquila. Mantiene una estricta rutina diaria tanto en el trabajo como en casa, donde pasa las noches junto a su madre escuchando boleros o viendo películas de la Época de Oro del Cine Mexicano en la televisión. Su rutina se ve alterada cuando su madre muere repentinamente. Su coqueteo con una joven camarera y su reencuentro con una antigua novia no pueden llenar el vacío dejado por su madre. Sin embargo, eso cambia cuando un día un hombre que dice ser su padre entra repentinamente a la tienda. El encuentro lo llevará a un viaje inesperado y que le cambiará la vida a Río de Janeiro.

programme.title: Asesinos Sin Ley
programme.desc: Mickey y Jenny son imigrantes indocumentados, un dia el patrón de Jenny trata de abusar de ella, Mickey lo sorprende y lo mata haceindo justicia por su propia mano así se desatan una cacería de criminales abusadores, todo lo sueben a las redes convirtiéndose en los anti-héroes más populares por hacer justicia a los desamparados.

programme.title: El Cóndor En Nueva York
programme.desc: Un narcotraficante de Nueva York, llamado Damián, ha creado una nueva droga con efectos impactantes. Después de varias muertes accidentales, la DEA y la policía se embarcan en una búsqueda inútil en busca de este jefe de la mafia. Damián comienza a derrotar a su competencia con la ayuda de su científico privado y un informante de la DEA. El hijo del alcalde Martínez (de Súper Cóndor) queda en coma tras consumir el nuevo medicamento. El alcalde Martínez vuela a Nueva York desde Perú para comenzar su propia investigación en busca de Damián y una cura. Todo parece sombrío para los agentes de la DEA, el alcalde Martínez y su hijo; hasta que llegue la ayuda. El Cóndor llega a Nueva York desde Perú para ayudar a revertir los efectos de esta nueva y brutal droga y llevar a Damián ante la justicia.

programme.title: Esposa de Vacaciones
programme.desc: Aprovechando la ausencia de su esposa, un hombre se sumerge en las tentaciones que ofrece el ciber espacio y conoce a una mujer casada. Ellos vivirán un romance idílico sin dimensionar las consecuencias.

programme.title: Aute Retrato
programme.desc: Recopilación de los mejores momentos de Luis Eduardo Aute en sus 50 años de carrera musical y artística. Un recorrido por sus distintas facetas creativas y sus bandas sonoras. Toda la vida el artista desvelada por un grupo de testigos, colaboradores y amigos que, a través de sus testimonios, demuestran el impacto que han tenido sus icónicas canciones sobre la actualidad musical.

programme.title: Al Acecho del Leopardo AKA Madrid- México
programme.desc: Durante un viaje por la selva mexicana, tres amigos, Román, Patricia y Lorena son testigos de una matanza de campesinos indígenas. Román graba en vídeo la masacre. El Suavecito, el jefe de los asesinos, se da cuenta y mata a Román y a Patricia. Aprovechando la confusión del tiroteo, Lorena logra escapar con la cámara y el vídeo. En su huida se encuentra con un grupo de enanitos toreros que la llevan hasta la ciudad de México. El Suavecito, que no quiere dejar testigos, la persigue implacablemente hasta una enorme plaza de toros, donde en una danza de la muerte, se escenificará la batalla entre el bien y el mal.

programme.title: Aquel Septiembre
programme.desc: En "Septiembre" la vida de Antonio se ve sacudida con el regreso de Carolina, su mejor amigo a quien no ve desde hace 6 años. Esta vez sus planes cambian, el amor comienza a juega con su corazón mientras Julián le hace descubrir los celos que nunca pensó encontraría. Carolina encuentra en Antonio a su mejor confidente y desahogo, sin sabiendo el daño que le hace al decirle todo lo que siente por Julián y hablando con él sobre su confusión por enamorarse de un amigo. Y es que pobre Antonio está enamorado de Carolina, su mejor amiga.

programme.title: Distopia
programme.desc: Impulsados por antiguos planes esotéricos, poderosas elites ocultas emplean armas bioquímicas, guerra psicológica, cuarentenas mundiales, e incluso magia negra para controlar el futuro de la humanidad y alcanzar la inmortalidad

programme.title: Er Relajo Del Loro
programme.desc: Un loro que tras ser vendido a unos traficantes de animales cuando era pequeño, va pasando de dueño en dueño durante toda su vida y cambiando su nombre de acuerdo a su propietario, mirando frente a sus ojos la evolución de Venezuela durante 50 años (1950/2000).

programme.title: Eros Una Vez María
programme.desc: María es el gran amor de Tonatiuh, pero él la pierde. Intenta mantener su esencia, buscando incansablemente en cada mujer que conoce, tratando de obtener tantas experiencias sobre ellas como pueda, para poder encontrar algo que le recuerde a su amor perdido. Todas esas mujeres tienen una particularidad: se llaman María.

programme.title: El Hormigón
programme.desc: El hormigón es un superhéroe que está harto de la mafia de su ciudad y decide combatirla con ayuda del Karate y la salsa.

programme.title: Abolición De La Propiedad
programme.desc: En un sótano oscuro, Norma escucha su voz y la de Everio en una vieja grabadora Ampex. Cada que él vuelve a bajar, la detiene. Han estado platicándose sus vidas, varias veces las conversaciones grabadas terminan coincidiendo con las charlas que ellos sostienen. Lo que le preocupa a Norma es que hasta ese día no conocía a Everio y lo último que escuchó fue que él la ahorcaba.

programme.title: El Deseo de Domingo
programme.desc: Narra la historia de Domingo, un adulto mayor que sufre Alzheimer y pasa sus días en un geriátrico en la ciudad de Viedma, desde donde intenta, a toda costa, viajar a la Capital, a San Isidro, a ver el gran premio de turf Carlos Pellegrini. Pero claro, no se trata de cualquier premio, sino el del año 1952. Para eso necesitará de la ayuda de Marcelo, su nieto, quien se encuentra en el dilema de conformarse con su puesto en una dependencia pública o seguir luchando por triunfar con su banda de rock. …

programme.title: Call TV
programme.desc: Lucía, una actriz en decadencia, acepta presentar un programa nocturno de preguntas tontas. Sin darse cuenta de que se ha metido en un gran lío que le hará pasar la peor noche de su vida

programme.title: ¿Quieres Ser Mi Rehén?
programme.desc: Ulises, un diseñador publicitario, es tomado como rehén por una hermosa y misteriosa mujer en el día más importante de su vida y en su propia oficina. Al mismo tiempo, la exesposa de Ulises acude a su oficina y complica todavía más la situación.

programme.title: Cartero
programme.desc: Hernán Sosa es un joven tímido que viene del interior a la ciudad. En su pueblo siempre estuvo enamorado de una chica inalcanzable, Yanina. Hernán consigue trabajo en el correo. Durante el reparto, Hernán descubre que Yanina se encuentra en la ciudad, en la zona de su reparto. En consecuencia, comienza a desplegar sus nuevos conocimientos de cartero para llegar hasta ella. Pero a medida que se acerca, descubre que unos viejos carteros están organizando un robo en el mismo edificio donde trabaja Yanina. Envalentonado por la fuerza del amor, Hernán se enfrentará a los peligros que rodean a Yanina para llegar a declararle lo que siente.

programme.title: Vidas Violentas
programme.desc: integrada por seis cortometrajes escritos y dirigidos por seis de los más connotados directores mexicanos, la película fue realizada y dirigida para concientizar y reducir la violencia de género, el acoso escolar en las escuelas y la violencia doméstica. Proviene de una iniciativa del gobierno en el marco de la campaña basta no violencia

programme.title: Despertar El Polvo
programme.desc: Es la historia de un hombre que ha sufrido las desgracias de vivir una vida trasgredida por la delincuencia y corrupción, el barrio de Iztapalapa es el escenario donde vaga por las calles, invisible, ignorado y solitario, sumido en su miseria. Un evento desafortunado mueve el instinto protector de Chano que intenta regresar al mundo del crimen para lograr sacar a su ahijado de la cárcel.

programme.title: De La Piel del Diablo
programme.desc: La atracción se desata entre un hombre y una mujer que se conocen en una galería de arte. Comparten gustos y aficiones, y ambos parecen ser justo lo que el otro necesita… pero lo que debería haber sido una noche de pasión, pronto se convertirá en un juego perverso, lleno de trampas y mentiras, en el que nada es lo que parece.

programme.title: El Ultimo Verano
programme.desc: Carlos es un Profesor de universidad a punto de jubilarse, pero su futuro se ve en peligro porque una de sus alumnas lo acusa de haber sido acosada. Esto es solo el inicio de la peor racha de su vida ya que Carlos descubre que su esposa lo engaña y que la vida que el creía perfecta se esfuma poco a poco de sus manos... tal vez sea el ultimo verano en la vida de Carlos

programme.title: Como El Gato y El Ratón
programme.desc: El barrio de La Estrella es uno de los más pobres de Bogotá. Allí habitan ciudadanos que han sido desplazados por la guerra y la violencia. Un día y tras años de espera, la luz eléctrica llega al barrio. La gente lo celebra y, pese a oponerse el edil, deciden usarla de manera ilegal. Todo se complicará cuando dos familias tengan un conflicto por unos cables cruzados.

programme.title: Dos Abrazos
programme.desc: Cuatro personas que se ven forzadas a defenderse ante la vida, un ensimismado chico de doce años, la cajera que tiene un encuentro con él, un airado conductor de taxi y la enajenada hija de uno de sus pasajeros, se reúnen en dos abrazos.

programme.title: El Bosque del Silencio
programme.desc: UNA MUCHACHA CONOCIO A UN HOMBRE POR INTERNET Y SE ENAMORA DE EL UN DIA DECIDIO IR A VERLO EN PERSONA, AUNQUE SU FAMILIA SE LO PROHIBIO ELLA DE CUALQUIER MANERA SE FUE PERO CUANDO LO VIO NO PODIA CREER LO QUE PASO

programme.title: Espacio Interior
programme.desc: Lázaro permanece secuestrado en un cuarto de tres metros cuadrados completamente aislado del mundo exterior. Obligado a revelar información íntima sobre sus familiares, cae en una desidia total. Al borde de la muerte, se da cuenta, esperanzado, de que su voluntad y su mente nunca podrán ser secuestrados. Es posible que jamás lo liberen, pero su gran fe y dignidad le muestran la inquebrantable naturaleza del espíritu humano.

programme.title: Error 113
programme.desc: Cuatro extraños se encuentran en el apartamento 113 invitados por Annie Annie, una aplicación de inteligencia artificial que ayuda a las personas con sus problemas cotidianos. Annie Annie les ha dicho que la aplicación es en realidad una persona real y que se van a encontrar cara a cara. Después de un tiempo, estos extraños comienzan a sentirse incómodos a medida que se dan cuenta de que Annie no va a poder hacerlo.

programme.title: El Campeón
programme.desc: LA HISTORIA DE UNA PROMESA DEL BOXEO, SU ENTRENADOR SOLO LO USA PARA BENEFICIO PROPIO. LA FAMA Y EL DINERO SOLO LE TRAE PROBLEMAS, ADEMAS QUE SUFAMILIA SE APROVECHA DE EL.

programme.title: Gritos del Monday
programme.desc: Un grupo de estudiantes de Ingeniería Ambiental realizan un trabajo en la Reserva Ecológica de los Saltos del Monday, conocido por su rica fauna y su rica historia. Para el trabajo, los alumnos deciden acampar en el lugar, en medio de la obscura noche son sorprendidos por un hecho que desencadenará a lo largo de sus días posteriores, en especial a una de las estudiantes.

programme.title: Choele
programme.desc: Todo ocurre en el pueblo de Choele Choel, provincia de Río Negro. Un niño y su padre intentan seguir juntos todo el verano, pero el chico ya decidió partir hacia otro lugar con su madre, cuando ésta llegue y le recoja. A la zona donde viven llega una chica, por la que comienzan a competir padre e hijo.

programme.title: Cuernavaca
programme.desc: El mundo de Andy cambia totalmente cuando su madre tiene un accidente. Sin nadie que lo cuide, es llevado a Cuernavaca, a la casa de su desconocida abuela paterna. Mientras su madre se debate entre la vida y la muerte, el niño se enfrentará a la frialdad de su abuela, al mundo seductor y peligroso del hijo del jardinero y a la búsqueda de su padre

programme.title: El Sonido de los Tulipanes
programme.desc: En Buenos Aires durante la crisis del 2001, Marcelo un escritor devenido en periodista, debe volver sobre los últimos pasos de su padre Tonio un consagrado intelectual de quien se encuentra profundamente distanciado cuando muere en condiciones extrañas. De la mano de Carolina la ex secretaria de su padre, Marcelo se sumerge en un mundo oscuro lleno de violencia y ambiciones de poder enfrentándose a “El Loco” Bertolini. Pero el peligro no solo lo acechará a él sino también a los suyos. ¿Podrá Marcelo encontrar los verdaderos motivos de la muerte de su padre?

programme.title: El Desertor
programme.desc: Luego de ser reclutado para el servicio militar y ante los abusos de su jefe inmediato, el Subteniente Montilla, Julián escapa del cuartel, lo que provoca una feroz persecución por parte de Montilla, quien se ha enamorado de Sagrario y hará todo lo posible para separar a los jóvenes.

programme.title: El Tercer Deseo
programme.desc: Eugenio, un corredor de bienes raíces despierta en una esquina de la ciudad con una descomunal borrachera y descubre cerca una desportillada tetera de metal. La toma y manosea a ver si es de plata y, de pronto, se le aparece el espectro de un duende que le sugiere formule tres deseos. El genio desaparece sin dar oportunidad al tercer deseo. Mas tarde, descubre que los deseos le han sido concedidos pero de forma equivocada. La vida de Eugenio se complica, solo anhela reencontrar la tetera abandonada y pedir el tercer deseo.

programme.title: El Retorno
programme.desc: Una extraña mujer mantiene expectante y desorientado al espectador cuando a diario habla con su hija y la presencia de su hija no aparece en ningún momento. Una historia no previsible que juega al despiste, por lo que, hay que esperar hasta el final para saber lo que está pasando la protagonista.

programme.title: ¡Ni Te Me Acerques!
programme.desc: Él solo tenía que cuidar el hotel y teclear su novela, como Jack Nicholson en “El Resplandor”, pero de buen rollo. Y Llega la cuarentena y se queda le pilla en el Hotel Balneario de Ariño haciendo frente a la paranoia general, el acoso de las fuerzas del orden, las videollamadas de su novia, su madre y del conspiranoico Javi... Todos nos aburrimos mucho en el primer confinamiento. Juan no.

programme.title: For Our Eyes Only Spanish
programme.desc: In anticipation of the 25th chapter in the iconic James Bond Saga, based on the novels of British writer Ian Fleming, Sabbatical Entertainment presents "For Our Eyes Only" an enthralling documentary that recounts and relives all of 007's menacing missions throughout this legendary cinematic franchise, from 1962's premiere of "Dr. No", to the highly anticipated "No Time To Die.

programme.title: Girl Gets Girl
programme.desc: Basada en la exitosa serie web española «Chica busca chica», Inés vive una vida encantadora con su bella novia. Todo su mundo se pone patas arriba cuando pierde un plazo de entrega por estar demasiado ocupada seduciendo a todas las mujeres atractivas con las que se cruza. Sin trabajo, sin dinero y sin novia, Inés se enfrenta a una existencia desconocida en un día de locura.

programme.title: Grey Eyes
programme.desc: En un futuro postapocalíptico, la humanidad es daltónica. Un brillante científico muere repentinamente, dejando su preciado maletín -lleno de una droga sintética altamente adictiva que permite a la gente volver a ver los colores- a Ana, una niña de 12 años. La posesión del maletín la convierte en el objetivo de un doctor con malvados planes para la droga, y su única esperanza de escapar de su persecución depende de la ayuda de los dos devotos guardaespaldas del científico muerto. Juntos, su épico y peligroso viaje gira en torno a un tremendo secreto: la propia Ana podría ser la clave para salvar un mundo en ruinas.

programme.title: I'm Ringo
programme.desc: El boxeador argentino Oscar Natalio Bonavena, conocido popularmente como Ringo, fue asesinado en la puerta de un burdel de Nevada, Reno, en Estados Unidos, en 1976. Ringo, que había peleado con Muhammad Ali, nunca había perdido la esperanza de tener la oportunidad de una revancha con el boxeador estadounidense.

programme.title: Influencer
programme.desc: Las redes sociales pueden ser un trampolín extraordinario hacia la fama y el éxito. Pero, ¿qué ocurre cuando a un influencer con 4 millones de seguidores le roban el móvil?

programme.title: Kruel
programme.desc: Kruel es un largometraje de terror/thriller sobre un asesino psicótico que se hace pasar por heladero para acercarse a los objetos de su afecto.

programme.title: La Granja del Horror [Pig Killer]
programme.desc: Basado en la aterradora historia real de Robert 'Willy' Pickton, el granjero de cerdos que se convirtió en un prolífico asesino en serie, cuyos horribles crímenes conmocionaron al mundo.

programme.title: Las Puertas del Infierno [Insidious Inferno]
programme.desc: Una cabaña aislada está plagada de una serie de horribles asesinatos, sin que los habitantes lo sepan, algo de otro mundo acecha dentro de los pasillos.

programme.title: Los Girasoles
programme.desc: Giovanna y Antonio, dos jóvenes napolitanos, se casan doce días antes del comienzo de la Segunda Guerra Mundial. Unos años más tarde, Antonio es dado por desaparecido en el frente ruso pero su esposa se niega a olvidarle. Armada con una fotografía de su amado, Giovanna viaja incansablemente por Rusia para encontrarle cueste lo que cueste.

programme.title: Many Pieces of Something
programme.desc: En medio de la jungla sexual de un festival de música en España, un grupo de jóvenes intenta alcanzar sus sueños.

programme.title: Masacre En El Bosque [Pillow Party Massacre]
programme.desc: Perseguidos por una broma que terminó en una tragedia, cinco amigos se reúnen para sanar sus heridas. Pero no todos son capaces de olvidar, y está claro que alguien, o algo, está buscando vengarse.

programme.title: Niño Perdido [Lost Child]
programme.desc: Una veterana del ejército regresa a su hogar y se encuentra con un niño perdido en el bosque. Mientras trata de buscar la identidad del chico, ella descubre un mundo de folklore y mentiras.

programme.title: One in a Thousand
programme.desc: Iris ha sido expulsada del colegio y pasa los días con sus primos. Cuando conoce a Renata, queda fascinada, y pronto empiezan a flirtear a pesar de los crecientes rumores sobre el pasado de Renata.

programme.title: Prosthesis
programme.desc: Un artista de prótesis con un pasado traumático encuentra un cadáver en su laboratorio. Mientras decide qué hacer con el cuerpo, tendrá que hacer malabarismos con su extraña vida familiar, la posibilidad de un nuevo amor, crear la prótesis perfecta para un cliente muy especial, todo ello en medio del rodaje local de una película de zombis.

programme.title: Restoration
programme.desc: Un hombre de 50 años se queda sin medios para mantener su estilo de vida basado en el placer y trama un plan muy cuestionable para vender la casa histórica de su madre sin que ella lo sepa. Para que no se entere, construye una réplica del dormitorio de su madre y le dice que la casa está prohibida mientras se restaura para devolverle su antiguo esplendor. Sorprendentemente, es el inevitable fracaso de su cruel y escandalosa ilusión lo que podría darle la oportunidad de restaurar su propia humanidad.

programme.title: Sadomaster
programme.desc: La violencia urbana extrema reina en Argentina. El senador Beccar Varela se alza como la única forma de frenar la violencia con su política de «tolerancia cero». La gente no sospecha que Beccar es el jefe de la banda nazi que provoca la violencia. Cuando los miembros de la banda torturan y violan a un retrasado, un misterioso vengador enmascarado comienza su brutal venganza contra las bandas y los políticos corruptos.

programme.title: Side-B
programme.desc: Wang Li-Sheng ha conocido a una chica española en Internet y ha decidido dejarlo todo y vivir su historia de amor en España. Las cosas no salen como él esperaba y acaba sin novia, sin dinero y sin pasaporte, por lo que tiene que buscarse la vida como inmigrante ilegal en un país del que no sabe nada. Su suerte cambiará cuando conozca a Marisa, una soñadora de sangre caliente que ha encontrado su lugar en este país; y a Mioara, una chica de Bucarest que llegó hace dos años buscando trabajo. Como suele ocurrir cuando somos jóvenes y las cosas suceden demasiado deprisa, sus corazones llevarán a estos desconocidos de los árboles por caminos no demasiado rectos.

programme.title: Maid
programme.desc: Cuando su señora contrata a otra sirvienta para que la ayude en las tareas domésticas, una criada amargada e introvertida causa estragos en la casa.

programme.title: Dirty Conscience
programme.desc: Dos jóvenes reclutas de la policía chilena son asignados a un duro y condecorado oficial para entrenarlos. Pronto queda claro que su nuevo jefe está implicado en graves casos de corrupción. Al principio, los dos jóvenes policías intentan hacer la vista gorda. Pero cuando su jefe empieza a dudar de su lealtad, los dos reclutas deben elegir entre salvar su honor y su carrera, antes de que su jefe los mate.

programme.title: Until You Untie Me
programme.desc: Una joven bailarina se sume en una desesperación emocional tras perder a su familia en un accidente mortal. Su camino de autodestrucción se enreda con un médico infame por mala praxis. Su encuentro desemboca en una febril historia de amor que explora el fetichismo, el sadomasoquismo y el bondage.

programme.title: Visiones Mortales [Scalper]
programme.desc: Todos a su alrededor, la psíquica Clementine Carter, están siendo brutalmente asesinados por un asesino enmascarado apodado "El Escalpador". ¿Es el psicópata muerto Andrew Lubitz vuelto de la tumba, un asesino imitador o un horror más allá de la imaginación? Clementine debe usar su segundo sentido para mantenerse un paso adelante de la cuchilla del maníaco y resolver el misterio.

programme.title: Wedding In New York
programme.desc: En España, la madre de Carlos le pide que les represente en una boda familiar en Nueva Jersey. Él acepta encantado la invitación, pero con un pícaro plan en mente: Convencerá a su buen amigo Gonzalo para que ocupe su lugar en la boda familiar y así poder visitar en secreto a su antiguo amor. Una serie de coincidencias se convertirán en grandes complicaciones cuando los dos amigos se encuentren enamorados de la futura novia y de la amante del novio.

programme.title: The Postman's White Nights
programme.desc: Quiet drama about the Russian soul, corruption and the postman from Lake Kenozero in northern Russia.

programme.title: The Dreamed Path
programme.desc: After a vacation romance, Kenneth and Theres lose sight of each other. But fate brings them together again 30 years later.

programme.title: Gisela

programme.title: The Grass is Greener Everywhere Else
programme.desc: Either the grass is greener, or the houses are bigger, or the sun is warmer ... anywhere else is better.

programme.title: She Is a Good Boy
programme.desc: When Ava's father Gunter, a classic macho dude, shows up at her door, worlds collide.

programme.title: Forces
programme.desc: Under the crushing emotional burden of his terminally ill father and violent brother, 14-year-old Daniel seeks refuge with two outcasts.

programme.title: Talk to Me
programme.desc: When a mother and her daughter take a vacation at the Baltic Sea, it quickly turns into a journey into the past that opens up old wounds.

programme.title: Youth Topia
programme.desc: In a world driven by algorithms, a group of "forever teenagers" rebel against the dictates of self-optimization.

programme.title: Burning Beds
programme.desc: Hamburg's housing shortage forces car inspector Gina and British pyromaniac Harry to move into the same apartment.

programme.title: Adam Ondra: Pushing the Limits

programme.title: Farewell Halong

programme.title: Floating

programme.title: Queen of Niendorf

programme.title: Rocket Perelman
programme.desc: In a quest for self-directed living, ten artists near Berlin join forces to start the artist's colony 'Rakete Perelman'. But, they need money.

programme.title: Brother
programme.desc: Lukasz (24) works for a big name in the industry. But after the death of his mother, his little brother Kamil (13) suddenly appears on his doorstep.

programme.title: Night of the Beast (aka Lucas child)
programme.desc: Lukas Armand, a skull-faced movie producer, is auditioning lovely young starlets for his upcoming low-budget Horror pic. The girls are delighted to learn they've been chosen to star in the film until Lukas' creepy gofers, Jason and Mad-dog kidnap the actresses, one by one, and lock the terrified girls in dank cells somewhere in the bowels of the film studio.

programme.title: Variant
programme.desc: When an artist struggling for purpose meets a mysterious yet charming stranger, she becomes entangled in his twisted attempts to 'relive the perfect moment'.

programme.title: The Final Shift
programme.desc: The tranquil haven of AL's Diner, harboring a scant collective of employees, patrons (including a hit man and his partner, a beautiful woman with a dark secret) and a devout Christian family, is thrown into chaos when a callow gang of four enters with a duffel bag of invaluable contents. After the gang's attempt to deliver the contents to the powerful and shady Maslow is derailed when one of them murders a cop inside the diner, suspicions and revelations arise among the group. While the gang struggles to keep control over the situation as more the police arrive, they quickly realize this is the least of their problems when Maslow comes to claim the contents of the bag.

programme.title: Await the Dawn
programme.desc: A troubled family traveling cross country are highjacked by a desperate man. Only to discover he's running from something more dangerous than he is.

programme.title: When Women Rule the World
programme.desc: Four young people get sucked into a time bending vortex to an apocalyptic future where women rule the earth.

programme.title: H.P. Lovecraft's The Old Ones
programme.desc: Captain Marsh was possessed by a Great Old One. Now free, he searches for a way to undo the horrors he committed, but a sinister cult has other plans.

programme.title: The Misty Green Sky
programme.desc: A young girl in another solar system asks an innocent question that sets off a chain reaction of adventure, destruction and tragedy.

programme.title: The Brain Machine
programme.desc: Several people volunteer for a scientific experiment about mind-reading and memory, but the experiment goes horribly wrong.

programme.title: Windstorm
programme.desc: Chaos. Disease. War and rumors of war throughout the world. Is this the end? For a group of strangers caught together fleeing Los Angeles, the answers are not so clear. And as the group takes shelter in the midst of a storm, one thing becomes apparent? the dangers of the world outside are nothing compared to what dwells among them in the shelter.

programme.title: Zombie Wars
programme.desc: Fifty years after a world-wide zombie epidemic had begun, a small group of rebel soldiers learn that intelligent zombies have begun breeding humans for food.

programme.title: Aliens Uncovered: Marilyn Monroe Exposed
programme.desc: With UFO abductions and close encounters, did the President attempt to disclose information in an unorthodox way, warning us of what was to come?

programme.title: Merc Force
programme.desc: In the right place at the wrong time...Prino Corvelli, Brice Creed and the crews of the Artemis and the Caladan are on a simple smash and grab mission on the planet Eden. Little do they know the dangers that await them.

programme.title: A Royal Makeover
programme.desc: When Ramone discovers he is the heir to the European Kingdom of San Pablo, he is daunted by the prospect of becoming king. Royal expert Angelica is hired to transform Ramone into the king he is destined to be.

programme.title: Mommy's Stolen Memories
programme.desc: 馬洛里的生活在她年幼的兒子比利被當地攀岩健身房的一位陌生女子吸引後顛倒過來。比利拒絕透露她說了什麼，並開始行為不端。

programme.title: Hashtag Proposal
programme.desc: A fake marriage proposal between two strangers . When all the attention starts to help them with their struggling lives and businesses, Millie and Leo play pretend, while trying to ignore their feelings.

programme.title: InstaFame
programme.desc: Since her divorce, Gwen and her teenage daughter Maddie make a great team and tell each other everything. It’s Maddie’s senior year and she’s excited to be reunited with her besties Kelly and Lacey again. Eager to be the coolest girls at school, the perfect way to gain instant popularity is posting selfies! When one of their social media stunts goes wrong, Maddie is blamed and the consequences are deadly. But Gwen knows she’s innocent. She’s determined to prove it and to protect her daughter from the real killer…

programme.title: The Story of Love
programme.desc: Ruby, an aspiring romance novelist, joins a writers retreat in Tahoe hosted by her literary hero and hottest writer around, Marcus Harlow, in order to win a lucrative book deal. But when Woody, the outdoorsy hotel owner, shows her the beauty of nature, Ruby wonders if she’s been writing the wrong kinds of stories to impress people like Marcus.

programme.title: Snowkissed
programme.desc: A travel-averse journalist chases her dream assignment, where she soon finds herself mentoring a handsome B&B owner who wants to be a tour guide.

programme.title: Pocket Dial Murder
programme.desc: Follows Stacey as she receives a pocket dial from her husband. She hears the death of a woman on the other end, and when her husband comes home, he says he has lost his phone.

programme.title: The Royal Bake Off
programme.desc: The rivalries of bakers Allie and Marily intensify when the Royal Prince of Samavia rolls into town looking for a royal baker. When Allie and the Prince hit it off, it seems he might be in the market for more than just a terrific cake.

programme.title: A Deadly Mistake
programme.desc: After graphics designer April gets into a car accident that leaves her boyfriend Patrick in a coma, she is subject to panic attacks. But does her new male friend have a hidden agenda?

programme.title: Stealing in Suburbia
programme.desc: After being home-schooled, Sky can't wait to get back into the high school experience and make some friends. But, when her new gang seems to prefer shoplifting to hanging out, Sky wonders whether she's fallen in with the wrong crowd.

programme.desc: Jenna is a fashion designer who works for her friend's boutique. Their failing business was saved by a famous influencer. When Jenna comes to a lavish Hamptons wedding, she was mistaken for her, but she decides to go along to save business

programme.title: Sparks Over Brooklyn
programme.desc: Single mom and chef Lidia sees her dreams for the future falling apart when arrogant tech innovator Danny buys her beloved family restaurant with plans to turn it into a busy dining experience.

programme.title: Danger on Party Island
programme.desc: Peguam pemalu Mel Dale patah hati apabila dia mendapati adik perempuannya yang berani telah meninggal secara tiba-tiba. Tetapi setelah dia pergi untuk membawa pulang mayat adiknya, dia mula merasakan bahawa ada sesuatu yang mencurigakan. Dan dia mungkin menjadi sasaran seterusnya.

programme.title: Secret Lives of College Escorts
programme.desc: Eve and her friend sneak out for a party, but her friend winds up dead and Eve loses her college scholarship. Soon she finds a job to pay for tuition but her job was a front for the dangerous sugaring scheme that caused her friend's death.

programme.title: Let Love Grow
programme.desc: Landscape architect Evie has met her match with her new client, stubborn archaeologist Ryan, but his daughters love Evie, and she soon finds herself the unwitting victim of Operation Grow a Girlfriend.

programme.title: A Bet with the Matchmaker
programme.desc: A relationship columnist on the brink of losing her job takes a bet with a self proclaimed match maker who guarantees to find her perfect match.

programme.title: Sister Dating Swap
programme.desc: When sisters Helena and Rachel are fed up with their love and work life, they agree to swap homes for 2 weeks. Yet what starts out as a holiday grows into a whole new perspective on their careers, life and most importantly, romance.

programme.title: Catfish Murder
programme.desc: Doing her best to balance a successful career with family life, a single mom's world spirals out of control when her shy teenage son is arrested for the murder of a young woman from the same high school.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: The four women who destroyed Rosa Blanco's life meet again in an empty house. Camila confronts Fausto accusing Patricia of being Leoncio's murderer. Once again a motorist warns her not to keep looking for her mother and snatches her letter.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Much confusion in Camila, nothing justifies the lies and Camila is increasingly disappointed in Mother Isabel's deceptions. Ezequiel confronts Julia and savagely assaults Gregorio when they are found together.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Mother Isabel confesses to Camila but the girl knows she is still lying. Jeli, her little sister, suffers because of Fernando's irresponsibility, who impregnated her. Max announces to Marcelina and Astrid that he will soon marry Camila.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Fausto hires Anton, a criminal, to assassinate Rosa Blanco; Camila and Max, happy, tell Father Tiziano about their upcoming wedding. Accompanied by Luciano, they summon Rosa to a busy street, but she does not appear. Meanwhile, Sebastian and Julia, Amelia and Gregorio, in their respective homes, share their sadness.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila explains to Ezequiel and Julia the reason for her happiness: she will marry Max, and will also soon be reunited with her mother. Through Luciano, Rosa sends her the address where they are going to meet, but Elda, furious, copies the data and reveals it to Inspector Torrealba who orders a police operation to arrest her.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila spots a woman matching her mother's description. Anton, the hitman, is also there and armed, he goes to them. Torrealba orders his men to run to the women, grab Camila and take the woman away.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Rosa Blanco makes a call to Fausto and disturbs Ezequiel with threats against him, Octavia and her entire family. Camila hears her mother's voice for the first time, but she tells her that she is calling her only to say goodbye, since they want to kill her. Camila receives a notebook sent by Rosa.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Only Camila should know the contents of what was written in the notebook. Her anger and rage grows and she thinks that her mother has the right to take revenge. Those involved feel fear and nervousness about the contents of the notebook. Max calls Camila and although she says she loves him very much, she does not express joy for the upcoming wedding.

programme.title: Innovation Has Its Way, Warmth Knows No Bounds
programme.desc: Have you ever seen a gala where robots take center stage? In Shanghai, a “Robot Gala” puts Chinese-made humanoid robots front and center — dancing, greeting customers, and even helping in classrooms. AI companions, from plush toys to holograms, are reshaping emotional connection in urban life. In Beijing, personalized tours led by multilingual guides help global travelers discover the Forbidden City and beyond. And in Thailand’s sugarcane fields, Chinese agricultural machinery is solving a labor crisis for local farmers. From cutting-edge technology to warm companionship, from cultural export to agricultural assistance, this episode of Meet China takes you to see how Chinese innovation unlocks a new picture of technology empowering life and cooperation promoting development.

programme.title: Beyond the screen: how “film ” tourism and AI redefine moviegoer experience
programme.desc: As the Beijing International Film Festival takes over the city, films are no longer just something we watch in cinemas. They’re connecting tourism, retail, entertainment, and even cutting-edge tech. What does this “film plus” experience look like for audiences today? And as AI reshapes the film industry, what opportunities and challenges lie ahead? Host Xu Yawen spoke with Li Lun, assistant professor of economics at Peking University; Geng Ling, film producer and CEO of China Film Assist Company; and Teng Jimeng, associate professor of American studies at Beijing Foreign Studies University, to delve into these questions.

programme.title: Level up with AI: What's new at this year's ChinaJoy?
programme.desc: The 23rd ChinaJoy 2026 takes place at Shanghai New International Expo Center with the theme "Level up with AI". Cherry Qiu brings an immersive visit to this grandest annual digital carnival.

programme.title: Xinjiang's role in Eurasia connectivity
programme.desc: From the bustling lanes of the world's largest bazaar in Urumqi to the humming logistics hubs at the region's 19 ports, Xinjiang is transforming its geographical advantage into economic strength. As China's gateway to the west, it now hosts a major network for opening-up, including the pioneering Pilot Free Trade Zone. This episode explores how cross-border trade, a web of China-Europe freight trains, and cultural exchanges are weaving Xinjiang into the very heart of the Belt and Road Initiative, making it a pivotal hub for continental connectivity.

programme.title: What can Africa learn from China’s poverty reduction experience?
programme.desc: Five years after China eliminated absolute poverty, its development experience continues to attract attention around the world, particularly across Africa. What lessons can African countries draw from China’s journey? Can China’s poverty reduction experiences be adapted to African realities? In today’s episode, we bring scholars, journalists and development practitioners from China, The Gambia, Rwanda and Namibia. Jainaba Sonko, Zhang Yanqiu, Patrick Rurangangabo and Jeronimo Kateya explore pathways to sustainable development and poverty reduction, discussing governance, infrastructure, education, self-reliance and the future of China-Africa cooperation.

programme.title: Behind CXMT IPO and China’s chip roadmap
programme.desc: As CXMT makes its market debut on Shanghai's STAR Market, the listing is drawing attention far beyond the trading floor. As China's top DRAM producer, CXMT sits at the center of the country's push to strengthen its semiconductor capabilities and build a more resilient technology ecosystem. What does the IPO mean for investors, the capital market, and the future of the global memory-chip industry? Join us on BizTalk as we explore market forces, policy priorities and the roadmap to technology self-reliance behind the landmark listing.

programme.title: Why China's theme parks are having a moment
programme.desc:
Looking for a cool summer escape with a twist? China’s theme parks are more than rides—they’re immersive worlds of blockbuster stories, spectacular shows, high-tech thrills, and local flavors.
Earlier this year, CGTN's Lincoln Humphries and Yu Hongyu explored two of China's best-known parks to see why they’re drawing crowds from across the country. From unforgettable live performances to next-level interactive experiences, discover a fresh way to travel in China.

programme.title: RAZOR: Artificial Vision
programme.desc: Around 40 million people worldwide are blind and a further 250 million are visually impaired. It's a disability that poses extraordinary challenges. At Miguel Hernandez University in Southern Spain, scientists have created a visual neuroprosthesis that's designed to restore a limited but useful sense of vision in profoundly blind patients. In essence, they are creating artificial vision. RAZOR's Gabrielle Lawrence meets the lead scientist Professor Eduardo Fernandez and hears from some of the patients involved in the study. These cutting-edge implants are designed to stimulate the retina or visual cortex, allowing users to perceive shapes, light, and potentially even detailed images. This pioneering work represents a major step forward in the field of neuroprosthetics and offers renewed hope for millions living with vision loss.

programme.title: Graphene
programme.desc: When graphene was first isolated in 2004, the so called "super material" was meant to change the world. The material has remarkable properties - it is 200 times stronger than steel, transparent, extremely light, flexible and also exhibits excellent electrical conductivity. Twenty years on it is starting to live up to the original hype and is being incorporated into a wide range of materials and products. RAZOR's Reya El-Salahi traveled to Cambridge to meet Prof. Sir Colin Humphreys, Co-founder and CSO of Paragraf, one of the first companies in the world to mass produce graphene-based electronic devices. Founded with Dr. Simon Thomas and Ivor Guiney in 2018, after a breakthrough they made at the University of Cambridge, the company now produces enough graphene to make 150,000 electronic sensors a day.

programme.title: 2026 WORLD ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE CONFERENCE SPECIAL | China’s Vision for AI Development and Global Governance
programme.desc: The 2026 World Artificial Intelligence Conference (WAIC) will conclude on 20th July in Shanghai. Join CGTN Biztalk on July 20 as it invites conference participants, industry observers and researchers to discuss the outcomes of the conference, and look into how China leverages WAIC as a premier industrial platform to foster dialogue, bridge divides, and promote shared governance.

programme.title: Architecture Intelligence: The Mission
programme.desc: An all-new documentary series and a true gift for engineering enthusiasts. Join CGTN's Yang Zhao on a captivating global journey, exploring a league of ambitious new engineering marvels. Uncover the extraordinary challenges and ingenious strategies behind these colossal structures. CGTN's award-winning Tech It Out studio embraces the popular short video format to innovate a brand-new style of engineering documentary and present "Architecture Intelligence," a nine-episode series. With our host Yang Zhao, we travel around the world and go beyond just witnessing mega-structures; we delve into the soul of each place we visit. We place architecture within the context of human lives, allowing it to serve as a lens through which we gain insights into a city, a nation and its culture.

programme.title: Meet China: When Chinese Dynamism Reshapes Landscapes — Boundless Challenges, Infinite Vitality
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we journey from the cloud-piercing peaks of Zhangjiajie to the tech-driven streets of Shenzhen and the cassava farms of Vietnam. We meet extreme athletes redefining personal limits, turning vertical cliffs and open skies into new playgrounds. Then, we ride in a fully autonomous robotaxi through Shenzhen traffic, exploring the technology and regulations accelerating the global race for self-driving cars. Finally, we travel to Vietnam, where Chinese investment and expertise have transformed the cassava industry—boosting yields, stabilizing farmer incomes, and creating resilient supply chains reaching global markets. From skies to roads to fields, this episode shows how China’s dynamism is reshaping landscapes and lives worldwide.
